taleLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Maya says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Raúl mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Dakota has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Maya says "The fire feels smaller now." Aki asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Henry has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marcus asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nadia breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nadia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Highbeam Deer — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marcus asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Henry breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Poulomi has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aki breathes "So it bleeds." Raúl asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Aki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry says quietly "We've been walking past those." Somchai asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Raúl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Poulomi mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Somchai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Raúl says "We've been walking past those." Aki says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nadia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Angela asks "Say that again — slower." Henry breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Dakota has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Bulldozer — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Poulomi asks "The fire feels smaller now." Henry says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunback — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. The mirror-scales catch the light — the glare builds, builds — then it launches, blind-fast, straight at where you were standing." "The thick tail lifts off the ground, swaying once — then sweeps like a felled tree. A monitor's tail is a battering ram with scales." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Mateo mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Raúl says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Maya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai breathes "Say that again — slower." Aki asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Angela has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dakota says quietly "Say that again — slower." Poulomi says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Poulomi has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Speedbump — I put it down today." "It doesn't move. It hasn't moved in an hour. Its head is suddenly somewhere else." "It seals itself. The shell clicks shut — nearly invulnerable. Wait it out, or flip it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nadia mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Dakota breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Henry has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Angela says "The fire feels smaller now." Maya mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Raúl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ducks in a row — I put it down today." "The hissing stops. The line leans forward — it advances, and contact burns." "Every beak in the line, one coordinated bite." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Marcus breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Maya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dakota mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nadia says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Raúl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Maya asks "We've been walking past those." Somchai asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nadia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Paparazzo — I put it down today." "The flash charges — whine rising. When it fires, you freeze in place." "Every shot refines its model — hit or miss. At 4, the money shot is unavoidable." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry says quietly "Say that again — slower." Angela breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Dakota has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Static — I put it down today." "It finds your voice in the static. It WEARS it. 'Help— help me—' in YOUR voice. Moving won't help once it has you." "It drops the voice. No static, no words — it RUSHES, no telegraph at all. Back off." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Mateo says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Redactor — I put it down today." "Its white edge-handles grab toward you — pointing. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph." "The black bars peel off the page — the redacted things come back, wrong and angry." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Poulomi asks "Say that again — slower." Nadia says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Henry has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Mateo mutters "Say that again — slower." Raúl mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nadia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Glasswing Darter — I put it down today." "A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky, straight at you." "It missed. It hits the dirt hard — wings splayed, vulnerable. Kill it now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Poulomi breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Somchai breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Poulomi has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Somchai breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Poulomi has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Spool — I put it down today." "RECORD first — harmless, it watches. Then REPLAY: the reels on its back spin, and the spinning reel SHOWS what's loaded. Watch the reel, not the tape." "RECORD. The reels turn slowly, drinking in everything you do. It is learning the shape of your turns." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dakota breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Mateo says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Somchai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Callback — I put it down today." "It speaks — in their voice, saying things they said. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track. The wrongness is the telegraph." "It studies you — tilting their head the way they tilted theirs. It is getting better at being them." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Mateo asks "And you're still standing." Saad breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
